lessons_used: Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) was helpful, but placing it after the adoption certificate severely degraded conversion (-22.4%).
Select new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration), targeted hints/clarifications, and specific layout redesigns (Stage, Scroll, Grid, Checklist) were helpful.
Adding multi-step setup flows (System Tray flow, Sound Verification flow) and several screen redesigns (Photo Upload Grid/Card, Split Pick Friend, Waiting Spotlight) hurt conversion (up to -23.3%).
Most standalone copy updates, waiting screen progress/tip carousels, audio cues, notification toggles, and select screens (Troubleshooter, Bio Preview, Controls Overview) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on features that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.
Predictions were often too low or negative (down to -8.0%) for winning changes that ultimately delivered large positive impacts (up to +14.0%).

candidates.title: Story Screen Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the Story screen using a split layout to present mascot backstory alongside onboarding options.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a short median time (8s) but a high mean time (514s), indicating some users stall on story introductory context.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout is an allowed change within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns have consistently delivered positive results (+3.2%).

candidates.title: New Path Selection Overview Screen
candidates.change: Add a new path introduction screen before path selection that highlights available pet companion styles.
candidates.why: Giving users a clear upfront summary of path options helps smooth initial onboarding drop-offs before path commitment.

new_path_intro.headline: Choose Your Companion Journey
new_path_intro.body: Explore different ways to create and interact with your new desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adding a new introductory screen while preserving all required onboarding steps is permitted.

candidates.score_note: New screens generally perform well, but extra steps in early pathing show modest gains.

candidates.title: New Pet Personality Intro Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a companion personality preview screen right before picking a friend to give context on pet behaviors.
candidates.why: The adoption step has the lowest step conversion rate in the funnel at 73.1% and a high median time of 89s.

new_pet_personality_intro.headline: Meet Companion Personalities
new_pet_personality_intro.body: Each pet brings unique behaviors and playful desktop interactions.

guard.reason: Adding a pet personality preview screen before pick_friend retains all required steps and fulfills rule requirements.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (73.1%), and new screens on adoption average +4.6%.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Carousel Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the Pick Friend screen using a carousel layout for browsing available companions smoothly.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is only 73.1%, making friend selection a primary funnel bottleneck.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend to a carousel layout maintains its functionality and is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns consistently hurt conversion (-7.8% across 6 tests).

candidates.title: Sign-In Re-login Account Sync Reminder Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original account to preserve pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again with different credentials.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary account to preserve and sync existing desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adding a sign-in hint for returning users is helpful and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 emails) and hints on sign_in reliably improve step completion (+2.4%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background System Readiness Note
candidates.change: Display a system background processing hint on the waiting screen reassuring users while their companion initializes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a huge mean time (2336s) and users report confusion when pets fail to display immediately.

waiting.hint: Your desktop companion is compiling in the background. Keep this app open while setup finishes.

guard.reason: Adding background processing information to the waiting screen complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Waiting screen info changes historically yield near-zero effect (+0.3%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Pet Activation Prompt
candidates.change: Enable a desktop activation notification prompt on the home intro screen to confirm pet spawning.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on the desktop screen or the app failing to launch.

home_intro.hint: Click launch to spawn your companion directly onto your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Enabling a desktop activation prompt on the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Notification prompts at finish have shown negative overall relative change (-1.6%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Screen Spotlight Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro completion screen using a spotlight layout to highlight final launch controls.
candidates.why: The finish step conversion drops to 80.0% with very high mean duration (5815s), showing hesitation at setup completion.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish redesigns show potential (+5.3%), though Spotlight layouts historically hurt.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Quality Requirement Clarification
candidates.change: Update the headline and body copy on the photo upload screen with clear lighting and framing instructions.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails regarding custom pet generation failing or producing incorrect visual results.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear, Well-Lit Photos
upload_photos.body: Ensure your photo is well-lit and front-facing for the best custom pet rendering results.

candidates.title: New Desktop Companion Interaction Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add an interaction guide screen before finish explaining how to summon, minimize, and talk to your pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails after onboarding expressing confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their new pet.

new_desktop_interaction_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_desktop_interaction_guide.body: Use desktop controls to hide or reveal your pet, and click your pet anytime to start talking.

guard.reason: Adding a desktop interaction guide screen before home intro retains all required onboarding steps and is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 emails; finish new screens reliably improve conversion (+3.1%).

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) and adding targeted sign-in clarification hints were helpful, but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely degraded conversion (-22.4%).

Adding specific interactive or setup-focused new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro) was helpful, whereas multi-step setup flows (System Tray flow, Sound Verification flow) hurt conversion.

Select layout redesigns (Stage adoption, Story scroll/stage/grid, Checklist intro) won, but redesigning photo upload layouts (Grid, Card, Split Pick Friend) and waiting screen spotlight severely hurt conversion (down to -23.3%).
Most audio cues, progress bars, tip carousels, notification enable toggles, and standalone headline updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly optimistic for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on features that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.
Predictions were frequently too low or negative (down to -8.0%) for winning features that delivered large positive impacts (up to +14.0%).
